title: Factorized derived inverse mate normalization
statement: For finite R, p:X→Y, and a cochain complex P of fixed-scalar modules on Y, the expanded representative equation holds with the exact-derived inverse-image isomorphism and mapDerivedCategoryFactors displayed separately before replacing their composite by the left-derived counit. This is the strict intermediate used to prove the counit-form equation.

source.place: Tags 07A6 and 0D6E; factorized derived mate normalization

proof.text: Expand the fixed inverse-image factor as the composite of the left-derived-to-exact-derived isomorphism and mapDerivedCategoryFactors; the resulting factorized chain is the normalized ordinary inverse mate square.
Apply the exact-derived mate normalization and identify the termwise factors with finiteScalarOrdinaryPullbackComparison, yielding the displayed factorized equation.
